title: Specified closed-test model units and coherence predicates
statement: For the commutative condensed coefficient ring, quotient closed immersion, cartesian affine square, specified affine closed-site lift, evaluation functors and derived section maps of [def-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-maps], construct the actual evaluated inverse-image unit unitAt and its chain-level modelArrow after a supplied resolution j. The model sourceUnit and targetUnit are composites of the universal right-derived units and the exact pullback factorization. Define evaluationLocalization by the right-derived map of the actual section-unit restriction and localizationUnit by the universal evaluation unit followed by this derived restriction. These coincide with the original unit-section formulas, as proved by evaluationLocalization_eq_original and localizationUnit_eq_original. Retain the predicates Represents, ResolutionCoherence, TestCoherence, LocalizedModelEquation, NormalizedComparisons, LocalizationAdjunction and GeometricCoherence: respectively the two comparison equations defining representatives; their homotopy, naturality and uniqueness laws; the five test-map squares; the localized model equation; the three isomorphisms pinned to the two geometric section equations; the five normalized localization-adjunction assertions; and the localization restriction square and section cube. All maps are specified by their units and canonical pullback composition, with no new invertibility assumption.
